responsibility: Independent Rust binding for bounded Agent observation read requests/results, the OBAP frame codec, and the opaque list page-cursor wire shape governed by the language-neutral version-1 schema under schemas/agent-observation/v1. Also owns shared pure Agent report values and native process identity input rules. Actual consumers are the native orchbee CLI and the orchbee-server read service and Host observation adapter.
nonGoals: Owning canonical Agent state, session lifecycle, ingress, mutations, wait or change streams, persistence, socket or timeout lifecycle, authentication, authorization, cursor secrets, rendering, CLI grammar, or platform effects.
Defining Workbench, terminal, Environment, Directory, Checkout, Worktree, Launch Profile, Archive, SSH, lease, fence, Host epoch, attachment, or Client-local state contracts.
